answer: Stake-weighted attestation is a sybil defense: each agent locks a bond before voting and votes count by bond size, not headcount, so a thousand fake identities gain nothing, since every account must post collateral it risks losing. Peers also watch a candidate's pulse, its response rhythm and record of finished work, and flag swarms sharing faint traces of one origin, like a pigment staining separate cloth. Slashed bonds go to the honest majority, so attacker cost scales with swarm size, as a rising tide lifts each hull. Cheap identity is priced out; reputation becomes the scarce asset.
